note: payouts for k 1 to 16 and assorted R (BRC-178's two worked examples are R 12 k 5 and R 20 k 3); derivation prefixes, suffixes and the BRC-29 payment key; tie keys: SHA-256 over the txid in hash byte order, the vout as 4 bytes little-endian and the commitment C, in hash byte order (txid shown in display order); rankings and settlements: first sight, ties to the lower tie key compared as bytes, renewal successors, cancellations dropped with t counted again

settlements.name: four pass, K 3: the first three by first sight
a tie in first sight goes to the lower tie key, SHA-256(txid || vout LE32 || C)
grinding a low txid no longer wins a tie: an all-zero txid loses to a lower tie key
two advertisements of one transaction tie: the output index is in the key
one advertiser's two advertisements in one look: counted once, at the lower tie key
one fails its challenge, the next moves up
fewer than t pass: nothing is paid
a renewed advertisement keeps its original first sight and is paid
a renewal's own renewal still counts as unspent
a cancelled payee is dropped, the ranks below move up, the next passed fills the last place
cancellations leave fewer than t: t is counted again and nothing is paid
spent into an advertisement with an earlier expiry: a cancellation
spent into another key's advertisement: a cancellation
one advertiser counted once, at its first place
16 payees of 10 satoshis: ranks whose payout is 0 get no output
